lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/ض/ى   q–ḍ–y judgement, verdict, to judge, to decree, to ordain
; case, fate; to decide, to plan, to entrust with; to fashion, to cut; to inform, to relate; to consummate, to complete, to carry out, to meet an obligation; death, to die, to expire; to annihilate, to demolish.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 63 times in the Qur’an:
قَضَى qaḍā 36 times; قُضِىَ quḍiya 23 times; قَاضٍ qādin 1 time; قَاضِيَةٌ qāḍiyatun 1 time and مَقْضِىّ maqḍiyy 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
قَضَى qaḍā i [v. trans.]

1 to decree, to decide upon

(2:117) إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ when He decrees something, He says only, ‘Be’ and it is‏

2 to bring about, to bring to an end

(8:42) وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدْتُمْ لاَخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِى الْمِيعَادِ وَلَكِنْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولا if you had promised each other [to fight/meet], you would surely have differed [in keeping] the appointment [but the battle had to take place] so that God might bring about a matter that was ordained‏‏ ‏

3 to judge, to issue a verdict, to pass a sentence

(4:65) فَلاَ وَرَبِّكَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّى يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ لاَ يَجِدُوا فِى أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًا مِمَّا قَضَيْتَ وَيُسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا no indeed, by your Lord, they will not be believers until they seek your arbitration in what [issues] arise between them and find no resistance in their souls to your judgements, accepting them totally

4 to fulfil, to complete

(33:23) مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَى نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ among the believers are men who were true to that which they pledged with God: some of them have fulfilled it [by dying in battle], and some are still waiting; *

(22:29) ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ ‏ then let them perform their acts of cleansing

5 to satisfy

(12:68) وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَهُمْ أَبُوهُمْ مَا كَانَ يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلاَّ حَاجَةً فِى نَفْسِ يَعْقُوبَ قَضَاهَا and, when they entered as their father had told them, it was of no avail to them against [the will of] God, it was merely a need in Jacob’s soul which he satisfied

6 to create, to fashion out

(41:12) فَقَضَاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَوَاتٍ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَى فِى كُلِّ سَمَاءٍ أَمْرَهَا so He fashioned them as seven heavens in two days, and assigned in each heaven its order

7 to fulfil a purpose, to satisfy a need

(33:37) فَلَمَّا قَضَى زَيْدٌ مِنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَاكَهَا لِكَيْ لاَ يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِى أَزْوَاجِ أَدْعِيَائِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا and when Zayd had satisfied a purpose with her [and when Zayd’s marriage with her came to an end], We gave her to you in marriage so that there should be no fault in believers marrying the spouses of their adopted children after they had satisfied a purpose with them [they were in the same situation]

8 [with prep. إلى] to relate, to make known to

(15:66) وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ الأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلاَءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُصْبِحِينَ We made known to him that decree: that the last remnants of those people would be wiped out as they entered into the morning

9 [with prep. على] to annihilate, to extirpate, to exterminate, to put an end to

(43:77) وَنَادَوْا يَامَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ مَاكِثُونَ and they will cry, ‘Mālik, let your Lord finish us off’: he will say, ‘You are to stay.’

entries.label: القَاضِيَةُ
entries.definitionHtml:
القَاضِيَةُ ʾal‐qāḍiyatu [fem. act. part.] one which destroys, or annihilates; death

(69:27) يَا لَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ الْقَاضِيَةَ if only it had been death!

entries.label: قَاضٍ
entries.definitionHtml:
قَاضٍ qāḍin [act. part.] one who decrees, one who decides, one who determines

(20:72) فَاقْضِ مَا أَنْتَ قَاضٍ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِي هَذِهِ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا so decide whatever you are deciding: you only decide on this present life. ‏

entries.label: قُضِىَ
entries.definitionHtml:
قُضِىَ quḍiya [v. pass.]

1 to be judged, arbitrated

(10:47) وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَسُولٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ every community is sent a messenger, and when their messenger comes judgement will be passed between them justly

2 to be concluded, to be brought to a successful conclusion

(11:44) وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ and the water was made to subside and the command was fulfilled and it [the Ark] came to rest on [Mount] Jūdiyy ‏

3 to be fulfilled, to be accomplished

(6:60) وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُمْ بِالنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ لِيُقْضَى أَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى He it is who gathers you at night, and knows what you have earned by day, then raises you up again in it [the daytime], that the term specified [for you] is fulfilled

4 [with prep. على] to be annihilated, to be exterminated

(35:36) وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا وَلاَ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِهَا as for those who disbelieve, for them is the fire of Hell, they will neither be annihilated and die, nor will they have its torment reduced for them.

entries.label: مَقْضِىّ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَقْضِىّ maqḍiyy [pass. part.] decreed, ordained

(19:21) وَلِنَجْعَلَهُ ءَايَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَقْضِيًّا and that We may make him a sign to all people, a blessing from Us–and it [the conception of Jesus] was a matter decreed.
